user_reported_bug: User has invoice INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0008 (Keretapi Tanah Melayu, converted from PI/0001, status=paid) which they want to renumber to INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0001 to fill the pre-existing audit gap. Number 0001 is unused (nothing voided/cancelled/deleted with that number). Number 0008 should be freed for the next new invoice.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Backend-only API/Mongo verification passed on fresh QA invoices: admin renumber of a paid invoice returned 200 with old/new numbers, MongoDB showed invoice_number and renumber audit fields populated, validation/authorization edge cases returned expected errors, GET paid invoices showed the new number, payment/receipt and journal source-id references remained usable, and the next new invoice reused the freed old number.
critical_code_review_comments: RenumberInvoiceRequest currently enforces only min_length for new_invoice_number; all executed positive tests used the required INV/MDDRC/YYYY/MM/NNNN format. If strict format enforcement is required, add regex validation.

Existing invoice journal entries remain linked by source_id; their human-readable source_reference/description still contain the old invoice number, while payment receipt lookup resolves the new invoice number by invoice_id. This was not functionally broken in the tested flow.
seed_data_creation: Created QA-only data via API: non-admin user qa.renumber.20260730134511@example.com; gap-holder invoice 31cc99fb-ac2e-4555-9ca8-b1a3fcd54dd9 moved from INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0003 to INV/MDDRC/2099/12/8313; paid target invoice c53b85da-1479-4e9a-b4a2-f228424fd1d7 renumbered from INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0004 to INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0003; payment b8e0bf26-2b55-4f09-be1a-fc28367ceb36; next invoice 984368e2-c989-408f-ba2d-45060f6f004c created as INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0004. Did not touch the real INV/MDDRC/2026/07/0008 invoice.

rca_of_the_issue: The fix adds POST /api/finance/invoices/{invoice_id}/renumber and updates only the invoice document's invoice_number plus audit fields. Runtime verification confirmed generate_invoice_number uses the current max invoice_number after renumber, so when the paid invoice that was the max is moved into a lower unused gap, its old number is generated for the next new invoice.
